drums.description: Industrial techno track at 135 BPM in the key of G minor, A distorted, heavy kick drum drives the rhythm with a short, metallic decay, A syncopated, resonant synth sequence with a high-pass filter sweep provides the primary melodic movement, Distorted percussion hits and industrial foley textures are layered on the off-beats, A dark, low-frequency drone sits in the background, while a sharp, percussive FM synth stab enters periodically with a short delay effect, The arrangement features a breakdown with a rising white noise snare roll and a high-pitched, oscillating lead synth that increases in resonance before the drop, Hi-hats are crisp with a short decay, playing a constant sixteenth-note pattern with occasional velocity accents Publish

bass.description: Indie rock, 110 BPM, key of E major, The track features a prominent, driving electric bass line played with a pick, characterized by a bright, slightly overdriven tone and frequent slides, A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic staccato chords and melodic lead lines with a light chorus effect, The drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and tight hi-hat patterns, A subtle, warm synthesizer pad fills the mid-range during the melodic sections, The arrangement alternates between bass-driven grooves and full-band sections where the guitar takes a melodic lead role Publish
